item.title: NEW: A snow record for Syracuse happened this winter
item.description: On December 30, 2025, Syracuse experienced its snowiest day on record with 24.2" of snowfall, surpassing the previous record of 34.0" from February 15, 1946.

item.title: ASAP Act targets faster solar energy growth, $1 billion annual savings
item.description: New York lawmakers and advocates are pushing for the ASAP Act, which would double the state's solar energy goals and save residents up to $1 billion a year, but faces opposition from Republicans over safety concerns and local farmland loss.

item.title: Sheriff's Office responds after Domino's delivery driver walks to Nancy Guthrie's front door
item.description: During a live taping of NewsNation, The Hill’s broadcast partner, the man was seen carrying several pizza boxes up the front steps of the residence belonging to the missing mother of TV host Savannah Guthrie’s home.

item.title: Oswego County child care funding forced to pause
item.description: Oswego County families in need of child care assistance will have to wait due to a shortage of funding from the state, resulting in a pause to the program, though some families will not be impacted.

item.title: At least five homicides in Syracuse solved with help of license plate readers, police department says
item.description: The Syracuse Police Department defended the use of license plate readers in the city, citing their benefits in fighting crime, while the Syracuse Common Council voted to transition from Flock-brand to Axon-brand readers due to concerns about data sharing with the federal government.

item.title: Apology turns to outburst during sentencing of Syracuse man who helped hide 5-year-old's body
item.description: Corrice Parks was sentenced to 14 years in prison for criminal possession of a weapon and concealment of a corpse, after helping his ex-girlfriend hide the body of her 5-year-old daughter in Syracuse, NY.

item.title: Baldwinsville teacher on leave; students seek answers
item.description: A teacher at Baldwinsville's C.W. Baker High School was placed on paid administrative leave, prompting a student-led petition calling for the teacher's return and a packed school board meeting with strong reactions from students and community members.

item.title: Syracuse Hometown Heroes banner program expands downtown
item.description: The Syracuse Hometown Heroes banner program has been expanded to the downtown area, allowing families and friends to sponsor banners honoring their veteran or active duty loved ones for $160 each.

item.title: Person detained for questioning in Nancy Guthrie search
item.description: Sources tell NewsNation the person was detained south of Tucson.
